measurement_scope: FleetOps app/domain events plus PostHog-shaped raw telemetry for all live synthetic accounts. Six named fleetops bible arcs are hand-scripted; the remaining accounts use deterministic archetypes with per-account/day perturbation. Each account includes compact checkpoint snapshots plus a bounded sampled timeline. Raw PostHog events are not treated as semantic product truth; UsageSignal rows are derived separately.

source_boundaries.derived_usage_signals: agent-facing rollups derived from raw events
source_boundaries.posthog: simulated raw PostHog events emitted from FleetOps app surfaces
